answer: An attester must stake 13% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the lagoon stake is held until the marble settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the sparrow audit lists each exposure. A farm running 151 keys as a result pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
